reason: A cross-platform desktop whale companion that monitors DSH status through read-only HTTP/SSE connections and presents visual and audio notifications with tray and configuration controls.

summaries.zh: 一款跨平台桌面鲸鱼伴侣，通过只读 HTTP/SSE 连接监控 DSH 状态，并提供悬浮显示、托盘控制和提示音通知。
summaries.en: A cross-platform desktop whale companion that monitors DSH status through read-only HTTP/SSE connections and provides floating visuals, tray controls, and sound notifications.

capabilities: Reads DSH status through HTTP polling and SSE connections
Displays status changes in a transparent always-on-top desktop window
Opens the DSH GUI in a browser on user interaction
Stores local display, sound, endpoint, and window-position settings
